title: Akiyama Mizuki — Between Feelings And Reality〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic!

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Yawn*... So sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really didn't want to come to school today, but my attendance has been getting pretty bad too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Worse if the teachers start coming after me about it... Hm?
*Whirr*...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? What was that sound...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (That's weird... I thought I heard Rui's drone flying around, but was it something else?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Finally, lunch...!
Why do classes have to be so long?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyways, I should go get something as a little reward... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Akiyama.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Long time no see.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Toya! Li'l bro! What's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you heading towards the store too?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! I need to hurry before they run out of what I want♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? What's wrong, li'l bro?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I told you to stop calling me that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But Ena told me about that picnic you all went on and how you saved her...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, that?
Yeah, I swooped in to save the day!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
To be fair, I wasn't alone.
I was actually with...!
Hello there! I was just looking for you...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: K-Kamishiro...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's been a while.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. First and second years really don't get many opportunities to interact with one another.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyways, I made something that you may find interesting. I was hoping to show it to you all today if you don't mind coming along with me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You in particular, Aoyagi. This may actually interest you the most.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Huh? Me?
If that's the case...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry, but we were just about to get lunch! Let's go, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? A-Akito...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! Don't leave me, li'l bro...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. Shall we, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Uh, sure...
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So what is it that you plan on doing? Just no explosions and stuff, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, nothing like that.
Here, take a look.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What is this? I see a big button attached to a speaker so... Is it a safety alarm for kids or something...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You're mostly on the right track.
Why not try pressing it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hold on... That usually means something bad's gonna happen. Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm sure. It'll just make a sound.
Please, feel free to press it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Just a sound? Well, if that's all then...
Here goes... Nothing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <Ha ha ha ha ha!!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?! Wait, is that Tsukasa's voice?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. Go on! Press it again!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh, okay... Again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <Whaaat?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: He said something different! What is this thing?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <Tenma, written as soaring pegasus!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <Wonderhoy!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha! Seriously, what is this thing?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <The one destined to become a star! His name is...!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <Razzle Dazzle Sunny Funny☆>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahahaha!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
This is really him?!
How many lines are there?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now I have to hear all of them!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, my sides... You made me laugh so hard...! You still haven't answered my question. What is this thing...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's an experimental prop for a show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've been thinking about how to use it and one might be to emulate instant transmission...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Instant transmission?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We could plant these within the audience and play them to draw attention away from the stage. During that time, cast members can appear or disappear as they like.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's a little dull now that you've explained it... You think that'll actually work?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It'll depend on how and when we use them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Again, they're still experimental, so it may be a while until we use them in an actual show.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I see. I kept thinking it was just a toy or something.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That thought did occur to me as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It looks so innocent and pointless, but I believe that it can make people laugh without much effort.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Wait...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Did he make this for me...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll be waiting on the rooftop again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Have you been waiting all this time for me...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, not at all. I've been flying a drone that tells me if you'd be coming up here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I knew it... That sound I heard earlier was his drone...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you ever feel the need to laugh for no reason whatsoever, I can lend this to you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll feel better if you do.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, you might be right...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Thanks, Rui.)
